briefing.headline: OpenAI o3 and xAI Grok-3 trigger fresh compute scramble as race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue aggressive model rollouts amid tightening GPU supplies. Regulatory scrutiny grows while investment flows remain robust. Multi-agent systems dominate deployment discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o3-preview with extended context; xAI launches Grok-3; Google DeepMind tests Gemini 3.0 internally. Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights under new license; DeepSeek R2 claims parity on key benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next month.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips; Microsoft announces $40B Texas data center expansion. Oracle and CoreWeave sign multi-year H100 lease deals totaling 180k GPUs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a US lab or a coalition of Chinese state-backed entities by 2028?
